diesel_policy: Do not treat bioethanol as diesel. Keep MTS diesel engines on their existing diesel/biodiesel-compatible fuel categories until DrewCraft has a real renewable diesel path.
notes: MTS matches configured fuels by fluid registry path; createaddition:bioethanol therefore uses the path bioethanol.
Potency 0.85 mirrors MTS's built-in ethanol potency for gasoline engines.
This patch is additive and must preserve any existing administrator fuel settings.
